methodology_source: canonical post-core photographic-methodology.md sections Theme and SIR, Relationship and self-presentation, Moment and meaning-led framing, Camera/light/texture, Prompt writing and review
final_direction: Keep the medium mirror view because face, phone, carrying hand, sewn seam and ruined material can remain connected. Relief has a visible material reason rather than a biographical claim. The admitted sf_097 lens-directed gaze acknowledges self-presentation without changing the useful hand tasks.
final_semantic_self_review: One bounded full review found requester self-photography and visible reference face/hair preserved, no explicit exclusions, no camera ownership invented, every adopted gaze relation realized in literal prose, and no contradictory phone-screen gaze remaining.
artistic_choice: Retain the original repair setting and material traces. A small hand mirror or independent reflected action would reduce this frame's useful record or add an unrelated contradiction. No further authorial detail is added to meet a quota.

pixel_observation_limits.active_lens: The runtime names the active rear lens, but activity cannot be proven from a still. Pixel review is confined to visible lens location, eye direction and reflection geometry.
pixel_observation_limits.eye_direction: If the pupils are too small or occluded at native scale, report UNOBSERVABLE rather than a derived gaze PASS.
pixel_observation_limits.hard_gate_boundary: The optional ordinary sf_097 candidate does not create an opt-in visual profile gate. Derived official hard gates and separate topic observations remain separate.
pixel_observation_limits.emotional_story: Visible stitches, damaged paper and a small smile may support a plausible repair-and-relief reading; the specific fictional festival history or actual inner state is not established by pixels.
